title: Format
description: Description of a file format. The file format classifies file objects and determines the valid form for the data.

@id.description: Unique identifier for the file format object.

fileFormat.description: Media type of the file format in the form of <type>/<subtype>.

pronom.description: List of PRONOM identifiers for the file format.

items.description: PRONOM identifier (fmt/xyz). PRONOM may present different profiles for the file format with unique PRONOM identifiers.

specification.description: List of JSON objects of containing name and location or other description of the specification.

items.description: A named resource for file format specification in the form of {name: location}
